annotations.title: Request a callback about a quote

description:
Use this when the user explicitly asks Cross Country Movers to call or email them about a quote they already received, and they agree to be contacted.

Do not use to calculate a price. Do not use before the user asks to be contacted and gives a name plus a phone number or email. Do not use for a household move, a long-distance move, an international move, or a car shipment until a quote tool has already run and the user asks for a call.

Input examples:

- quote_id: the id returned by the quote tool. name: Sam Lee. phone: 555-0100. consent: true.
- quote_id: the id returned by the quote tool. name: Sam Lee. email: sam@example.com. consent: true.
name: request_callback
title: Request a callback about a quote
